old_problem: Pending inputs were GPU scope, pinned burn-tool semantics and signed environmental/health limits, all bindable before execution.
disposition_reason: ED-03 supports UUID/BDF/tool bindings, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 retains the full duration, and ED-15 requires signed load and health limits in addition to the tool's PASS string.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row41 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3078 and actual next row42/history3079 were read.
Every intended GPU needs stable UUID/BDF/topology identity and a pinned binary/config; one GPU or process exit is insufficient.

test_case.test_name: GPU burn for 12 hours at 0C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify every intended GPU sustains the approved burn load for 12 hours at cold/high-rail margin without compute, XID, ECC, PCIe, thermal, power or platform failure.
required_package: Pinned burn binary/checksum/config and load floor
Signed per-GPU health and environment limits
Abort, dry warm-up and nominal restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions, verify all GPU identities, run the pinned burn profile for 12 hours with continuous per-GPU health telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every target remains loaded, the approved tool result is PASS, no signed health/event limit is violated, and post-restoration inventory and health are normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all intended GPUs, full duration, pinned tool semantics and independent telemetry; a lone PASS string, one GPU or shortened smoke run cannot pass.
safety_gate: Preserve logs and maintain OOB heartbeat
Abort on moisture, thermal/power, XID/ECC/AER or heartbeat limit
No auto-retry; warm above dew point before access
expected_evidence: Tool result, XID/AER/SEL deltas, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry safely, restore GPU policies/services, verify inventory/health and do not auto-retry.
